short_description.text: Shelomith is a person named in Scripture (Lev.24.11).
Dibri is a person named in Scripture (Lev.24.11).
Azazel is a place named in Scripture (Lev.16.8–Lev.16.26).

who.text: God, Moses, Aaron and the priests.

where.text: At Mount Sinai and the tabernacle.

when.text: Traditionally set at Sinai in the second millennium BC; modern dating proposals vary.

what.text: Instructions for sacrifice, priesthood, purity, holiness and the Day of Atonement, calling Israel to be holy as God is holy. Genre: Law and ritual instruction.

before.text: Follows the tabernacle being set up at the end of Exodus.

stakes.text: Explains how a holy God may dwell among an unholy people.
